map.计算瞳孔中心到镜框下缘垂直距离，用于渐进多焦点镜片定位: Compute the vertical distance from the pupil center to the lower rim of the frame, used for progressive multifocal lens positioning
map.📖 查看「瞳高定位器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Pupillary Height Locator User Guide"
map.瞳孔中心到镜框下缘距离 (mm): Distance from pupil center to lower frame rim (mm)
map.瞳高占 B 值比例 = 瞳高(mm) / 镜框 B 值(mm) × 100%: Pupillary height as a fraction of B = pupillary height (mm) / frame B value (mm) × 100%
map.比例 50%–70% 为光学中心位置正常；偏低光学中心偏上、偏高偏下，影响装配与: A ratio of 50%-70% means the optical center position is normal; a low value places the optical center higher, a high value lower, affecting assembly and visual quality.
map.直接测量法：让佩戴者自然平视，用瞳高尺测量瞳孔中心到镜框下缘沟槽的垂直距离。: Direct measurement method: have the wearer look straight ahead naturally and measure the vertical distance from the pupil center to the lower frame rim groove with a pupillary height ruler.
map.瞳孔中心到镜框上缘距离 (mm): Distance from pupil center to upper frame rim (mm)
map.公式法：瞳高 = 镜框垂直高度B − 瞳孔中心到镜框上缘距离。: Formula method: pupillary height = frame vertical height B − distance from pupil center to upper frame rim.
map.瞳高对单光片影响小: Pupillary height has little effect on single-vision lenses
map.瞳高过小会导致渐进镜片近用区被截断，阅读视野不足；瞳高过大则远用区缩小。一般瞳高: Too small a pupillary height truncates the near zone of a progressive lens, leaving insufficient reading field; too large shrinks the distance zone. Generally a pupillary height of 55%-65% of the frame B value is appropriate.
map.瞳高测量需在镜架实际佩戴调整后进行，建议使用瞳距仪或数码定位系统精确测量。: Pupillary height measurement should be done after the frame is actually worn and adjusted; using a pupillometer or digital positioning system for precise measurement is recommended.
map.渐进/双光片需测单眼瞳孔高度。: Progressive/bifocal lenses require measuring the monocular pupillary height.
map.定光学中心垂直位置。: Determine the vertical position of the optical center.
map.镜圈下缘到瞳孔中心 22mm、通道 17mm → 近用区中心 22−17=5mm: From lower rim to pupil center 22 mm, corridor 17 mm → near zone center 22−17=5 mm; mark and then align the optical center during assembly.
map.瞳孔高差 2mm 致渐进通道偏，阅读区上移/下移造成「看不清近」或头晕，须重测。: A 2 mm pupillary height difference shifts the progressive corridor, moving the reading zone up/down and causing "can't see near clearly" or dizziness; it must be re-measured.
map.要。脸不对称使左右瞳孔高不同，尤其渐进片，均分会导致一侧不适。: Yes. Facial asymmetry makes the left and right pupillary heights differ; especially for progressive lenses, averaging causes discomfort on one side.
map.是。水平（单眼 PD）+ 垂直（瞳孔高）共同定位光学中心，缺一不可。: Yes. The horizontal (monocular PD) + vertical (pupillary height) jointly locate the optical center; neither can be omitted.
